descripcion_corta: A fan-made conversion of the MSX version of Gradius for the NES.
descripcion_larga: This version brings specific levels and mechanics from the MSX hardware (like the Bone planet) to the NES, offering a unique "alternate" take on the classic shooter.

objetivo: Defeat the Bacterion forces in this promotional special version.
descripcion_corta: A rare promotional edition of Gradius released in Japan.
descripcion_larga: Distributed as a prize by a food company, this version is functionally similar to the original but is highly sought after by collectors for its historical context.

objetivo: Fly through alien worlds and use the power-up bar to upgrade.
descripcion_corta: The definitive NES port of the legendary Konami arcade shooter.
descripcion_larga: Known for its iconic power-up system (Speed Up, Missile, Laser, Options), it set the standard for the genre and introduced the famous Konami Code.

objetivo: Fly through alien worlds and use the power-up bar to upgrade.
descripcion_corta: The original Famicom release of the legendary "Nemesis" series.
descripcion_larga: A pixel-perfect home version that captured the arcade's intensity, featuring memorable bosses like the Big Core and the iconic Moai heads.

objetivo: Fly through alien worlds and use the power-up bar to upgrade.
descripcion_corta: The definitive NES port of the legendary Konami arcade shooter.
descripcion_larga: Known for its iconic power-up system (Speed Up, Missile, Laser, Options), it set the standard for the genre and introduced the famous Konami Code.

objetivo: Lead the Vic Viper through even more dangerous alien zones.
descripcion_corta: A stunning Famicom sequel featuring the custom VRC4 chip.
descripcion_larga: One of the most impressive technical feats on the system, Gradius II features massive bosses, improved graphics, and the ability to choose different power-up loadouts.

objetivo: Survive new waves of enemies in this fan-enhanced edition.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality hack that adds content and fixes to the Gradius engine.
descripcion_larga: This version features new levels and improved color palettes, breathing new life into the classic 8-bit shooter with modern design sensibilities.

objetivo: Battle through fantasy realms to defeat the dark lord.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced and visually impressive action game by Varie.
descripcion_larga: Featuring huge sprites and intense boss battles, Grand Master allows players to switch between different weapons and magic to adapt to the challenging fantasy enemies.

objetivo: Use different SD (Super Deformed) heroes to stop a global threat.
descripcion_corta: A crossover action game featuring Ultraman, Kamen Rider, and Gundam.
descripcion_larga: Players can switch between three iconic Japanese heroes, each with unique abilities, to navigate stages and defeat enemies in this charming 8-bit brawler.

objetivo: Train your boxer and win the professional championship belt.
descripcion_corta: A technical boxing simulation with a heavy focus on training.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Vic Tokai, this title requires players to manage their boxer's stats through training mini-games before entering the ring for strategic 8-bit bouts.

objetivo: Match card values and suits to clear the board and score points.
descripcion_corta: A refined and strategic card-based puzzle game for the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Blending elements of Poker and Solitaire, it challenges players to think ahead and create winning combinations under time pressure to progress.

objetivo: Drive your heavy tank through enemy lines to destroy the headquarters.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of the cult classic "Iron Tank."
descripcion_larga: Developed by SNK, it features non-linear paths and a wide variety of weapon upgrades, allowing players to choose how they approach the massive warzone.

objetivo: Find Waldo and specific items in crowded, colorful illustrations.
descripcion_corta: An 8-bit adaptation of the famous "Where's Waldo?" books.
descripcion_larga: Players move a cursor over large scrolling maps based on different historical or fantasy themes, testing their observation skills against the clock.

objetivo: Match tiles to dismantle the "Great Wall" in this 8-bit puzzler.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed puzzle game by Sachen with a Mahjong-style theme.
descripcion_larga: Featuring classic tile-matching mechanics, players must strategically remove pieces from a large wall without getting stuck, aiming for the highest score.

objetivo: Master the greens across the USA with the "Great White Shark."
descripcion_corta: A technical golf game featuring unique terrain-mapping technology.
descripcion_larga: This title stands out for its "TrueView" system, allowing players to survey the course from different angles, and for including real-world course data.

objetivo: Guide Gizmo through the Clamp Center to stop the Gremlin invasion.
descripcion_corta: A gorgeous Sunsoft production with top-tier music and graphics.
descripcion_larga: Known as one of the best-looking games on the system, it features tight controls and creative gadgets that Gizmo uses to navigate through the hazards of the skyscraper.

objetivo: Guide Gizmo through the Clamp Center to stop the Gremlin invasion.
descripcion_corta: A gorgeous Sunsoft production with top-tier music and graphics.
descripcion_larga: Known as one of the best-looking games on the system, it features tight controls and creative gadgets that Gizmo uses to navigate through the hazards of the skyscraper.

objetivo: Guide Gizmo through the Clamp Center to stop the Gremlin invasion.
descripcion_corta: A gorgeous Sunsoft production with top-tier music and graphics.
descripcion_larga: Known as one of the best-looking games on the system, it features tight controls and creative gadgets that Gizmo uses to navigate through the hazards of the skyscraper.

objetivo: Infiltrate the alien base and destroy the Red Falcon core.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of the legendary "Contra."
descripcion_larga: This version is superior to the US release due to the custom Konami VRC2 chip, which adds animated backgrounds (trees, snow) and story cutscenes between levels.

nombre: Gryzor (Japan) [En by MadHacker v1.0] [Fix by g8z et al] (Contra Version)
objetivo: Experience the enhanced Japanese version with full English text.
descripcion_corta: The definitive way to play Contra on the NES in English.
descripcion_larga: This fan translation brings the superior graphics and cutscenes of the Japanese Gryzor to Western players while keeping the iconic "Contra" title and feel.

nombre: Gryzor (Japan) [En by MadHacker v1.0] [Fix by g8z et al] (Gryzor Version)
objetivo: Experience the enhanced Japanese version with its original title.
descripcion_corta: A fan translation that maintains the "Gryzor" branding and story.
descripcion_larga: Like the Contra version, it features the animated backgrounds and cutscenes missing from the US release, but keeps the European/Japanese naming convention.

objetivo: Explore a massive world to activate ten safety keys and save Earth.
descripcion_corta: A brilliant hybrid of "Zelda-style" exploration and "shmup" action.
descripcion_larga: Players control a transformer that explores a world on foot and turns into a starfighter for boss battles. It is highly regarded for its deep upgrades and music.

objetivo: Explore a massive world to activate ten safety keys and save Earth.
descripcion_corta: A brilliant hybrid of "Zelda-style" exploration and "shmup" action.
descripcion_larga: Players control a transformer that explores a world on foot and turns into a starfighter for boss battles. It is highly regarded for its deep upgrades and music.

objetivo: Explore a massive world to activate ten safety keys and save Earth.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of "The Guardian Legend."
descripcion_larga: Featuring the same incredible mix of exploration and intense vertical shooting, it is a cult classic that showcases the best of 8-bit hybrid design.

objetivo: Lead a revolution to overthrow a dictator in a tropical nation.
descripcion_corta: An intense and fast-paced SNK shooter with unlimited continues.
descripcion_larga: Based on the story of Che Guevara and Fidel Castro, the game features non-stop action, tank segments, and a high level of destruction throughout its levels.

objetivo: Overthrow a cruel dictator and liberate the island nation.
descripcion_corta: An intense and fast-paced SNK shooter with non-stop action.
descripcion_larga: Known for its infinite continues and heavy firepower, players fight through jungles and cities, rescuing hostages and destroying tanks in this classic arcade port.

objetivo: Lead the revolution as Che Guevara to liberate the island.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of "Guerrilla War."
descripcion_larga: Unlike the Western version, this one explicitly names the protagonists Che Guevara and Fidel Castro, staying true to its historical (though stylized) revolutionary theme.

objetivo: Help Mr. Stevenson jump and avoid obstacles by shooting him.
descripcion_corta: A unique NES Zapper game that combines platforming and shooting.
descripcion_larga: Instead of shooting enemies, you shoot the protagonist to make him jump over pits and obstacles, requiring a mix of rhythm and precise aim.

objetivo: Destroy the enemy fleet and save humanity from a mechanical threat.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced shooter based on the Japanese sci-fi film.
descripcion_larga: Known for its incredible speed and variety of power-ups, Gun Hed (also known as Blazing Lazers on other systems) is a technical marvel on the Famicom.

objetivo: Defeat the bizarre galactic army of mutated objects.
descripcion_corta: Widely considered the best vertical shooter on the NES/Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Compile, it features insane weapon variety, shops to buy upgrades, and a level of polish that pushed the NES hardware to its absolute limit.

objetivo: Defeat the bizarre galactic army of mutated objects.
descripcion_corta: Widely considered the best vertical shooter on the NES.
descripcion_larga: A masterclass in 8-bit game design, offering lightning-fast action without slowdown, customizable weapons, and some of the most creative boss fights on the system.

objetivo: Infiltrate enemy territory and take down a criminal organization.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of "Laser Invasion."
descripcion_larga: Developed by Konami, it supports the Zapper and features first-person shooting segments combined with strategic helicopter flight sequences.

objetivo: Chase down criminals and uncover a dark conspiracy in the city.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of "Vice: Project Doom."
descripcion_larga: An incredible hybrid game that features high-speed driving levels, first-person shooting, and top-tier ninja-style platforming action.

objetivo: Collect bounties by defeating the most dangerous outlaws in the West.
descripcion_corta: A brilliant Capcom arcade port set in the Wild West.
descripcion_larga: Unique for its control scheme where you use three buttons to shoot in different directions, players must upgrade their horse and weapons to survive.

objetivo: Collect bounties by defeating the most dangerous outlaws in the West.
descripcion_corta: A brilliant Capcom arcade port set in the Wild West.
descripcion_larga: Players control Billy Bob through desert towns and canyons, fighting through waves of bandits to confront legendary bosses in high-stakes duels.

objetivo: Pilot an advanced helicopter and destroy enemy sea and air forces.
descripcion_corta: An early Taito shooter focusing on tactical helicopter combat.
descripcion_larga: Players must manage two types of fire: forward-facing cannons for air targets and a movable crosshair for ground and sea installations.

objetivo: Help Professor Hector collect dynamite while avoiding Smicks.
descripcion_corta: One of the two games designed for use with the R.O.B. robot.
descripcion_larga: Players (or the robot) must press buttons to move red and blue pillars, creating paths for the Professor in this slow-paced but strategic puzzle game.

objetivo: Travel through the solar system to reach Earth while destroying aliens.
descripcion_corta: A unique 360-degree shooter that blends Galaga and Tempest.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Konami, this NES version adds power-ups and epic boss battles at each planet, all set to an iconic 8-bit Bach-inspired soundtrack.

objetivo: Travel the land to find the four heroes and defeat the demon king.
descripcion_corta: An early and complex RPG with an emphasis on exploration.
descripcion_larga: Known as "The Seal of the Dragon," it features a massive world map and a unique combat system where positioning and party management are key to survival.

objetivo: Use your giant hammer to fight through construction sites and cities.
descripcion_corta: A charming and difficult action game by Irem.
descripcion_larga: As Harry, players must smash enemies and projectiles to stop a corrupt construction company. It features great humor, big sprites, and tough boss fights.

objetivo: Guide a young couple through the music industry to become stars.
descripcion_corta: A quirky and notoriously difficult game about the road to fame.
descripcion_larga: Players control two characters simultaneously, navigating through various stages filled with hazards that represent the struggles of a pop music career.

objetivo: Defeat opponents in the traditional Japanese card game Hanafuda.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed and more "mature" take on the classic Hanafuda game.
descripcion_larga: Featuring high-quality 8-bit art, this title offers various modes and opponents to challenge your mastery of the "Flower Cards" rules.

objetivo: Defend your castle and conquer others using "Egg" monsters.
descripcion_corta: A humorous and innovative RTS game developed by Square.
descripcion_larga: Players manage a kingdom and summon monsters from eggs to fight battles. It’s famous for its parody of RPG tropes and its slapstick humor.

objetivo: Collect items and avoid hazards to reach Bugs' birthday party.
descripcion_corta: Known in the West as "The Bugs Bunny Birthday Blowout."
descripcion_larga: Bugs uses a mallet to defeat enemies through colorful levels based on classic Looney Tunes shorts, featuring guest appearances from the whole cast.

objetivo: Complete the stunt course and beat the clock in 3D perspective.
descripcion_corta: A fascinating prototype of the ambitious 3D arcade racer.
descripcion_larga: This unreleased port attempted to recreate the arcade's polygons using the NES's limited hardware, offering a glimpse into early 3D console experimentation.

objetivo: Perform tricks and win games in this comedic basketball sim.
descripcion_corta: A licensed game featuring the world-famous trick basketball team.
descripcion_larga: Players can perform signature Globetrotters moves and mini-games, blending traditional basketball gameplay with the team's iconic entertainment style.

objetivo: Navigate through fantasy stages using magical powers.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed Chinese action game featuring a "Harry Potter" theme.
descripcion_larga: This bootleg attempts to bring the magic of the boy wizard to the NES, featuring unique sprites and spell-based combat in various themed levels.

objetivo: Navigate through fantasy stages using magical powers in English.
descripcion_corta: The English-translated version of the Chinese Harry Potter bootleg.
descripcion_larga: This translation makes the menus and simple story of the unlicensed action game accessible to English-speaking collectors and players.

objetivo: Manage your farm, grow crops, and raise animals in 8-bit form.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed Chinese "demake" of the famous farming series.
descripcion_larga: This bootleg attempts to shrink the SNES/Game Boy experience onto the NES, featuring basic farming mechanics and town interaction in a simplified format.

objetivo: Stack five identical hats to clear them from the screen.
descripcion_corta: A quirky puzzle game designed by the creator of Tetris.
descripcion_larga: Instead of blocks, players manage different types of hats (crowns, top hats, etc.). It requires strategic stacking to prevent the piles from reaching the top of the shop.

objetivo: Stack five identical hats to clear them from the screen.
descripcion_corta: The Western release of Alexey Pajitnov's hat-stacking puzzler.
descripcion_larga: Featuring the same addictive gameplay as the Japanese version, it challenges players to master the unique physics and sorting logic of 8-bit millinery.

objetivo: Defeat opponents in the traditional game of Go (Igo).
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced digital version of the classic Eastern board game.
descripcion_larga: Featuring a specialized AI for quick decision-making, it allows players to practice and compete in Go matches with various difficulty settings on the Famicom.

objetivo: Infiltrate the base and assemble the "Heavy Barrel" super weapon.
descripcion_corta: An intense Data East arcade port with 360-degree shooting.
descripcion_larga: Players fight through waves of enemies to find keys for red lockers containing pieces of a devastating energy cannon, using it to clear the most difficult bosses.

objetivo: Infiltrate the base and assemble the "Heavy Barrel" super weapon.
descripcion_corta: A high-action military shooter known for its powerful upgrades.
descripcion_larga: Similar to "Ikari Warriors" but with smoother gameplay, it features diverse environments and a heavy emphasis on collecting weapon parts to gain temporary invincibility.

objetivo: Navigate dangerous downhill slopes and perform tricks to finish.
descripcion_corta: One of the few dedicated snowboarding games on the NES.
descripcion_larga: Players must manage speed and balance across various terrain types, from powdery snow to icy peaks, avoiding obstacles in a race against the clock.

objetivo: Explore a surreal world and find your friends to escape.
descripcion_corta: A cult classic "Metroidvania" known as "Ufouria" in the West.
descripcion_larga: Featuring a bizarre and charming art style, players switch between four unique characters (a penguin, a cat-ghost, etc.) to use their specific abilities to reach new areas.

objetivo: Destroy the biological and mechanical invaders across time.
descripcion_corta: A high-difficulty shooter known in the West as "Starship Hector."
descripcion_larga: Developed by Hudson Soft, it alternates between vertical and horizontal scrolling stages, requiring players to master both ground and air-based attacks.

objetivo: Help Bakabon's Papa navigate through chaotic and surreal levels.
descripcion_corta: A humorous action game based on the famous comedy manga.
descripcion_larga: Players use an umbrella as a weapon and tool to navigate strange environments, capturing the absurd and slapstick humor of the legendary Fujio Akatsuka series.

nombre: Heisei Tensai Bakabon (Japan) [En by KingMike v1.0] (~Genius Bakabon, The)
objetivo: Navigate surreal levels with fully translated comedic dialogue.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the wacky Famicom action title.
descripcion_larga: This version makes the absurd jokes and level objectives clear, allowing Western fans to enjoy one of Japan's most iconic comedy franchises in 8-bit.

objetivo: Pilot a combat aircraft and destroy waves of demonic enemies.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed military shooter with a dark, intense theme.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Sachen, it features relentless enemy patterns and a variety of power-ups, challenging players to survive a "hellish" battlefield from start to finish.

objetivo: Water all the flowers in each garden while avoiding enemies.
descripcion_corta: A cute and colorful puzzle-platformer featuring Hello Kitty.
descripcion_larga: Kitty must navigate through platforms to reach flower beds, using her watering can and avoiding moles and bees in a family-friendly 8-bit adventure.

nombre: Hello Kitty no Ohanabatake (Japan) [En by Suicidal v1.0] (~Hello Kitty's Flower Shop)
objetivo: Tend to your flower shop gardens with translated menus.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of Kitty's floral puzzle adventure.
descripcion_larga: This version makes the level instructions and cute story segments accessible, perfect for younger players or Sanrio fans using the original hardware.

objetivo: Navigate through themed worlds using a magical balloon.
descripcion_corta: A Hello Kitty-themed remake of the game "Balloon Kid."
descripcion_larga: Players must tap buttons to flap their balloons and stay airborne, navigating through obstacles and collecting items in this charming 8-bit platformer.

nombre: Hello Kitty World (Japan) [En by Flake v1.0]
objetivo: Navigate themed worlds with translated English text.
descripcion_corta: An English fan translation for the balloon-based adventure.
descripcion_larga: This patch replaces the Japanese text, making the world names and simple story accessible to English-speaking fans of the Sanrio mascot.

nombre: Hello Kitty World (Japan) [En by HK Kicks Ass v1.0]
objetivo: Navigate themed worlds with a more "edgy" fan translation.
descripcion_corta: An alternative English translation with a humorous/rough tone.
descripcion_larga: A community-made translation that adds a bit of 90s-style "attitude" to the text of the otherwise innocent Hello Kitty game.

nombre: Herakles no Eikou - Toujin Makyou Den (Japan)
objetivo: Journey across ancient Greece to defeat the God of Hades.
descripcion_corta: The first entry in the "Glory of Heracles" mythological series.
descripcion_larga: Inspired by Dragon Quest, it features a heavy focus on Greek myths, challenging players to gather legendary items and talk to gods to complete their quest.

nombre: Herakles no Eikou 2 - Titan no Metsubou (Japan)
objetivo: Stop the resurrection of the Titans and save the world.
descripcion_corta: A vastly improved sequel with deeper mechanics and story.
descripcion_larga: Featuring a more advanced combat system and a moving narrative, it is considered one of the most underrated RPG gems on the Famicom.

nombre: Herakles no Eikou 2 - Titan no Metsubou (Japan) [En by Spoony Bard v1.31] (~Glory of Heracles 2, The - Titans' Downfall)
objetivo: Stop the Titans with full English translated lore and menus.
descripcion_corta: The high-quality fan translation of the second Herakles title.
descripcion_larga: This translation allows Western players to fully enjoy the epic mythological story and the improved 8-bit RPG mechanics of the Data East classic.

objetivo: Complete various dungeon quests to defeat the evil Morcar.
descripcion_corta: An unreleased prototype based on the famous board game.
descripcion_larga: A fascinating 8-bit adaptation that captures the turn-based movement and combat of the original tabletop game, featuring several different hero classes and quests.

objetivo: Defeat your opponent in the "Dark" version of Chinese Chess.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed digital version of An Qi (Hidden Chess).
descripcion_larga: Played on a half-board with face-down pieces, this game focuses on luck and strategy as pieces are revealed and captured in a unique tactical loop.

nombre: Higemaru Makaijima - Nanatsu no Shima Daibouken (Japan)
objetivo: Explore seven islands to find the hidden treasure of the pirates.
descripcion_corta: An expansive adventure based on the "Higemaru" arcade game.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Capcom, players throw barrels at enemies to clear paths. It features a non-linear map where players must sail between islands to find keys and bosses.

nombre: Higemaru Makaijima - Nanatsu no Shima Daibouken (Japan) [En by Snark v1.0] (~Seven Islands Adventure)
objetivo: Explore the islands and find pirate treasure in English.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of Capcom's high-seas adventure.
descripcion_larga: This translation makes the clues given by NPCs and the names of the islands clear, which is essential for solving the game's many navigational puzzles.

objetivo: Achieve the highest score and trigger the multi-ball police chase.
descripcion_corta: A faithful port of the classic Williams arcade pinball machine.
descripcion_larga: Known for its fast-paced action and car-chase theme, the NES version includes bonus mini-games and accurate table physics for 8-bit pinball fans.

objetivo: Achieve the highest score and trigger the multi-ball police chase.
descripcion_corta: A faithful port of the classic Williams arcade pinball machine.
descripcion_larga: Known for its fast-paced action and car-chase theme, the NES version includes bonus mini-games and accurate table physics for 8-bit pinball fans.

objetivo: Race against the clock through various stages to reach the finish line.
descripcion_corta: A high-speed racing game by Square, known as "Rad Racer" in the West.
descripcion_larga: Featuring impressive 3D-style scaling and a selectable soundtrack, it was one of the first games to offer a 3D mode using specialized anaglyph glasses.

nombre: Hinotori - Houou Hen - Gaou no Bouken (Japan)
objetivo: Collect phoenix feathers to rebuild the legendary firebird.
descripcion_corta: A Konami classic based on Osamu Tezuka's famous "Phoenix" manga.
descripcion_larga: Players control Gaou, who can create tiles to use as platforms. It features a unique branching path system and massive bosses across different historical eras.

objetivo: Complete various learning activities with the show's mascots.
descripcion_corta: An educational title based on a popular Japanese children's TV show.
descripcion_larga: Gachapin and Mukku guide children through simple logic, math, and word puzzles, designed with the colorful and friendly aesthetic of the 8-bit era.

nombre: Hirake! Ponkikki (Japan) [En by Gil Galad v1.01]
objetivo: Complete learning activities with translated instructions.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the Ponkikki children's game.
descripcion_larga: This version makes the educational mini-games accessible to English speakers, allowing children to enjoy the 8-bit lessons without the language barrier.

nombre: Hirake! Ponkikki (Japan) [En by Unknown v1.0] (~Open! Ponkikki)
objetivo: Complete learning activities with translated instructions.
descripcion_corta: An alternative English translation of the Ponkikki educational title.
descripcion_larga: Similar to other versions, it translates the menus and prompts, providing a clear path through the various 8-bit learning challenges.

nombre: Hiryuu no Ken - Ougi no Sho (Japan)
objetivo: Master the dragon arts to win the world martial arts tournament.
descripcion_corta: The first entry in the series known in the West as "Flying Dragon."
descripcion_larga: It blends side-scrolling exploration with a unique "mark" system in one-on-one combat, where players must strike specific points on an opponent.

nombre: Hiryuu no Ken II - Dragon no Tsubasa (Japan)
objetivo: Defeat the Dark Wizard and his army using mystical dragon powers.
descripcion_corta: An expanded sequel with improved combat and cinematic cutscenes.
descripcion_larga: This entry introduces more specialized moves and a deeper story, following the "Flying Warriors" as they battle supernatural threats across the globe.

nombre: Hiryuu no Ken III - 5 Nin no Ryuu Senshi (Japan)
objetivo: Lead five dragon warriors to stop the ultimate evil from rising.
descripcion_corta: A multi-protagonist sequel featuring different martial arts styles.
descripcion_larga: Players can choose between five different characters, each with their own unique attacks and special skills, adding variety to the series' tactical combat.

nombre: Hiryuu no Ken Special - Fighting Wars (Japan)
objetivo: Compete in a dedicated world tournament with refined mechanics.
descripcion_corta: A special edition focusing primarily on the one-on-one fighting mode.
descripcion_larga: This version polishes the combat engine and provides a streamlined tournament experience for fans of the "Hiryu no Ken" mark-based fighting system.

objetivo: Challenge and defeat the masters of various rival dojos.
descripcion_corta: A martial arts strategy and fighting game for the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Players must train their character and then travel to different schools, using a mix of tactical decision-making and real-time combat to prove their strength.

objetivo: Take on contracts to eliminate corrupt officials in Edo Japan.
descripcion_corta: A stealth-based action game based on a popular period drama.
descripcion_larga: Players control different "executioners" who use unique tools to navigate levels and assassinate targets, blending story adventure with strategic combat.

objetivo: Hit as many marmots as possible before the time runs out.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed 8-bit recreation of the classic "Whack-a-Mole" arcade game.
descripcion_larga: Simple and fast-paced, it tests the player's reflexes as they try to clear the screen of moles while avoiding penalties in this colorful bootleg.

nombre: Hit the Ice - VHL the Video Hockey League (USA) (Proto)
objetivo: Win the VHL championship in this aggressive arcade-style hockey game.
descripcion_corta: An unreleased NES prototype of the famous comedic hockey hit.
descripcion_larga: Known for its large sprites and violent "power shots," this version offers a look at how the arcade's slapstick hockey was being ported to the 8-bit system.

objetivo: Rescue Super Joe and stop the resurrection of an ancient leader.
descripcion_corta: The uncensored Japanese version of "Bionic Commando."
descripcion_larga: Unlike the Western release, this version contains Nazi imagery and explicit references, featuring the famous grappling hook mechanic and non-linear level choice.

objetivo: Distinguish between gangsters and civilians in a shooting range.
descripcion_corta: A classic NES Zapper game that tests speed and judgment.
descripcion_larga: Players must shoot target cutouts of criminals while sparing innocent bystanders, featuring several modes including a "trick shot" game involving tin cans.

nombre: Hokkaidou Rensa Satsujin - Okhotsk ni Kiyu (Japan)
objetivo: Solve a series of linked murders across the Hokkaido region.
descripcion_corta: A pioneering menu-driven detective adventure by Yuji Horii.
descripcion_larga: As a police detective, you must investigate crime scenes and interview suspects. It is famous for its mature story and for being a precursor to the visual novel genre.

objetivo: Navigate the wasteland and defeat Shin to rescue Yuria.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the first "Fist of the North Star" game.
descripcion_larga: As Kenshiro, players use deadly pressure-point attacks to make enemies explode, featuring challenging platforming and iconic 8-bit martial arts action.

nombre: Hokuto no Ken (Japan) [En by Stardust Crusaders v1.0] (~Fist of the North Star)
objetivo: Navigate the wasteland with fully translated dialogue and menus.
descripcion_corta: An English fan translation that restores the original anime context.
descripcion_larga: This version uses the original Japanese names and lore, providing a more authentic experience for fans of the legendary anime and manga series.

nombre: Hokuto no Ken 2 - Seikimatsu Kyuuseishu Densetsu (Japan)
objetivo: Continue Kenshiro's journey against the celestial emperor's forces.
descripcion_corta: A sequel featuring larger sprites and more intense combat.
descripcion_larga: Based on the second half of the series, players fight through waves of enemies using upgraded techniques and power-ups to face the strongest rivals.

nombre: Hokuto no Ken 2 - Seikimatsu Kyuuseishu Densetsu (Japan) [En by Extreme Fun v0.50] (~Fist of the North Star 2) (Incomplete)
objetivo: Continue Kenshiro's journey with partially translated text.
descripcion_corta: An English fan translation for the second Hokuto no Ken title.
descripcion_larga: While incomplete, it makes the basic menus and story beats accessible for those wanting to play the 8-bit sequel to the "Fist of the North Star."

nombre: Hokuto no Ken 3 - Shin Seiki Souzou Seiken Restuden (Japan)
objetivo: Experience the entire Hokuto no Ken saga in a massive RPG quest.
descripcion_corta: A deep RPG that covers the story from the beginning of the series.
descripcion_larga: Unlike the previous action games, this entry features turn-based combat and party management, staying extremely faithful to the original manga's epic plot.

nombre: Hokuto no Ken 4 - Shichisei Haken Den - Hokuto Shinken no Kanata he (Japan)
objetivo: Lead a new generation of warriors in an original Hokuto story.
descripcion_corta: The final Famicom entry, featuring an original plot set after the series.
descripcion_larga: It features improved 8-bit graphics and a refined combat system, allowing players to create their own legacy in the post-apocalyptic world of the North Star.

objetivo: Get three symbols in a row by agreeing or disagreeing with celebrities.
descripcion_corta: A digital version of the popular Tic-Tac-Toe themed game show.
descripcion_larga: Players must judge if the "celebrities" in the squares are telling the truth or lying, testing both their general knowledge and their sense of human psychology.

objetivo: Defeat the black slayer and reclaim the royal family's power.
descripcion_corta: A cult classic known for its Heavy Metal aesthetic and high difficulty.
descripcion_larga: Playing as Ronnie, you use magic spells to fight through gothic levels. It is famous for its intricate sprite work and for being a love letter to 80s rock icons.

objetivo: Defeat the black slayer with fully translated story and menus.
descripcion_corta: An English fan translation of the Heavy Metal-themed action gem.
descripcion_larga: This version allows players to follow the dark fantasy plot while navigating the game's brutal platforming challenges and boss encounters.

objetivo: Hide and set traps to avoid being caught by the Wet Bandits for 20 minutes.
descripcion_corta: A game of cat and mouse based on the hit Christmas movie.
descripcion_larga: Players control Kevin McCallister, running through the mansion to collect valuables and drop traps like lightbulbs and toys to stall Harry and Marv until the police arrive.

objetivo: Hide and set traps to avoid being caught by the Wet Bandits for 20 minutes.
descripcion_corta: A revised version of the movie tie-in with minor bug fixes.
descripcion_larga: This revision addresses small glitches in character movement and trap interaction, providing a more stable experience of Kevin's solo defense of his home.

nombre: Home Alone 2 - Lost in New York (Europe)
objetivo: Evade the Wet Bandits and navigate the hazards of New York City.
descripcion_corta: The PAL version of the sequel, featuring varied city environments.
descripcion_larga: Unlike the first game, this is a more traditional platformer where Kevin uses weapons like a dart gun to fight off enemies in hotels, parks, and construction sites.

nombre: Home Alone 2 - Lost in New York (USA)
objetivo: Evade the Wet Bandits and navigate the hazards of New York City.
descripcion_corta: A challenging platformer based on Kevin's big adventure in the city.
descripcion_larga: Players must navigate through iconic movie locations like the Plaza Hotel, using various gadgets to defeat enemies and escape the persistent Harry and Marv.

objetivo: Lead your team to victory in a full baseball season.
descripcion_corta: A high-energy Famicom baseball title by Data East.
descripcion_larga: Known for its fast gameplay and detailed player stats, this game focuses on the "Pennant League" experience, offering a deep simulation of Japan's favorite sport.

nombre: Home Run Nighter '90 - The Pennant League (Japan)
objetivo: Win the championship in the updated 1990 baseball season.
descripcion_corta: An improved sequel with updated rosters and refined graphics.
descripcion_larga: This version features smoother animations and expanded tactical options for pitching and batting, representing the peak of the 8-bit Nighter series.

objetivo: Win games of Janken to progress through different stages.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed "mature" themed puzzle game from the Asian market.
descripcion_larga: Using simple rock-paper-scissors mechanics, players compete against various opponents. It features high-quality 8-bit character art typical of unlicensed Famicom titles.

objetivo: Lead Danpei's team to the national dodgeball championship.
descripcion_corta: An intense dodgeball game based on the popular manga and anime.
descripcion_larga: Featuring special "super shots" and dramatic animations, players must manage their team's health and positioning to knock out all opponents on the court.

nombre: Honoo no Doukyuuji - Dodge Danpei (Japan) [En by TransGen v1.0b] (~Dan's Dodge Ball)
objetivo: Win the dodgeball championship with fully translated menus.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the first Dodge Danpei game.
descripcion_larga: This version makes the team management and special move names accessible, allowing Western fans to enjoy the over-the-top 8-bit sports action.

objetivo: Conquer the international dodgeball tournament with Danpei.
descripcion_corta: An improved sequel featuring bigger sprites and more special moves.
descripcion_larga: This entry expands the roster and adds more complex team strategies, making the dodgeball matches even more fast-paced and cinematic than the original.

nombre: Honoo no Doukyuuji - Dodge Danpei 2 (Japan) [En by TransGen v1.0a] (~Dan's Dodge Ball 2)
objetivo: Win the international tournament with translated text.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the second Dodge Danpei title.
descripcion_larga: This patch clarifies the updated mechanics and story beats, providing the definitive way to experience Danpei's second quest for dodgeball glory.

objetivo: Defeat high-ranking AI opponents in traditional Japanese chess.
descripcion_corta: A professional-grade Shogi simulator endorsed by Master Naitou.
descripcion_larga: Featuring deep AI routines and various handicap settings, this title is designed for serious students of Shogi looking for a challenge on the Famicom.

objetivo: Rescue Peter Pan's children from the clutches of Captain Hook.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality platformer based on the Spielberg fantasy film.
descripcion_larga: As Peter Pan, players fly, swim, and fight through Neverland. The game is praised for its beautiful 8-bit graphics and faithful recreation of the movie's atmosphere.

objetivo: Rescue Peter Pan's children from the clutches of Captain Hook.
descripcion_corta: The Famicom version of the cinematic Hook adventure.
descripcion_larga: Featuring the same polished gameplay as the Western releases, it showcases some of the best visual effects and animations available on the 8-bit hardware.

objetivo: Rescue Peter Pan's children from the clutches of Captain Hook.
descripcion_corta: A polished movie-licensed platformer with great music and visuals.
descripcion_larga: Players explore forest and pirate ship levels, using a dagger and magical flight to overcome obstacles and confront the legendary Captain Hook.

objetivo: Win the street basketball tournament in 1-on-1 or 2-on-2 matches.
descripcion_corta: A gritty urban basketball game focusing on half-court play.
descripcion_larga: Known as "Moero!! Junior Basket" in Japan, it features large character sprites and allows for a more aggressive, arcade-style take on the sport.

objetivo: Win the street basketball tournament in 1-on-1 or 2-on-2 matches.
descripcion_corta: A gritty urban basketball game focusing on half-court play.
descripcion_larga: Players can choose from different fictional neighborhoods and players, each with unique stats, in this fast-paced 8-bit streetball simulation.

nombre: Hoshi no Kirby - Yume no Izumi no Monogatari (Japan)
objetivo: Recover the Star Rod and restore dreams to Dream Land.
descripcion_corta: One of the most technically advanced and beloved games on the NES.
descripcion_larga: Known as "Kirby's Adventure," it introduced Kirby's ability to copy enemy powers. It features incredible graphics, massive levels, and a battery-backed save system.

objetivo: Lead a group of psychics to uncover the truth about a dying world.
descripcion_corta: A notoriously difficult and surreal post-apocalyptic RPG.
descripcion_larga: Famous for its strange mechanics, lack of guidance, and unique sci-fi atmosphere, it has gained a cult following as one of the most "challenging" Famicom games.

nombre: Hoshi wo Miru Hito (Japan) [En by KingMike v0.80] (~Stargazers) (Incomplete)
objetivo: Lead the psychics through the dying world with translated text.
descripcion_corta: An English fan translation for the cult classic Hoshi wo Miru Hito.
descripcion_larga: While the game remains difficult, this translation helps clarify the cryptic dialogue and menus of this very unusual 8-bit role-playing experience.

nombre: Hoshi wo Miru Hito (Japan) [En by KingMike v0.80] (~Stargazers) (SRAM Saving) (Incomplete)
objetivo: Lead a group of psychics in a dying world with save support.
descripcion_corta: The fan-translated version of Hoshi wo Miru Hito with a save fix.
descripcion_larga: This version adds SRAM support to the notorious RPG, allowing players to save their progress properly, making the brutal journey through the psychic wasteland more manageable.

objetivo: Infiltrate the embassy, eliminate terrorists, and rescue the hostages.
descripcion_corta: A tactical simulation known as "Rescue: The Embassy Mission."
descripcion_larga: Players control a team of snipers and a dynamic assault squad. It features multiple phases, from positioning snipers to rappelling down walls and clearing rooms in first-person.

objetivo: Win big on various themed slot machines to unlock rewards.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed adult-themed casino game for the NES.
descripcion_larga: Featuring high-quality 8-bit character art for its time, this game simulates various slot machines with different themes, focusing on the luck of the draw to gain credits.

objetivo: Unify Japan during the Sengoku period through military conquest.
descripcion_corta: A deep historical war simulation based on a popular manga.
descripcion_larga: Players manage resources, troop placements, and diplomacy. It’s known for its detailed maps and strategic depth, typical of late-Famicom historical sims.

objetivo: Dig through the earth to find lava-cooling items and save the world.
descripcion_corta: A digging adventure game similar to "Dig Dug" but with more exploration.
descripcion_larga: As Hottarman, you navigate underground mazes, managing your air supply while using drills and bombs to clear paths and defeat subterranean enemies.

nombre: Hottarman no Chitei Tanken (Japan) [En by Six Feet Under v1.0] (~Hotman)
objetivo: Dig through the earth to save the world with translated text.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the digging adventure "Hottarman."
descripcion_larga: This translation makes the mission objectives and item descriptions clear, allowing players to focus on the strategic digging and survival mechanics of the game.

objetivo: Defeat mythological Japanese demons in a dark fantasy setting.
descripcion_corta: A challenging platformer featuring traditional Japanese Yokai.
descripcion_larga: Players navigate through atmospheric levels based on folklore, using various weapons and magic to cleanse the land of evil spirits and powerful bosses.

objetivo: Lead the legendary Yellow Emperor on a quest to unify ancient China.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed Chinese RPG with a heavy focus on mythology.
descripcion_larga: Featuring large sprites and a complex world map, this bootleg title attempts to bring the scale of 16-bit RPGs to the Famicom hardware.

objetivo: Infiltrate high-security buildings to steal three Da Vinci artifacts.
descripcion_corta: A creative action game based on the Bruce Willis film.
descripcion_larga: Players must use stealth, timing, and various gadgets to bypass guards and complex security systems, emphasizing clever movement over brute force.

objetivo: Infiltrate high-security buildings to steal three Da Vinci artifacts.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese release of the movie-inspired heist game.
descripcion_larga: Featuring the same polished mechanics as the Western versions, this Famicom title captures the quirky tone and puzzle-like platforming of the "Hudson Hawk" film.

objetivo: Infiltrate high-security buildings to steal three Da Vinci artifacts.
descripcion_corta: A creative action game based on the Bruce Willis film.
descripcion_larga: Players must use stealth, timing, and various gadgets to bypass guards and complex security systems, emphasizing clever movement over brute force.

nombre: Hudson's Adventure Island - Classic in the Pacific (Europe)
objetivo: Rescue Princess Leilani by surviving various tropical islands.
descripcion_corta: A compilation or specific PAL release of the foundational platformer.
descripcion_larga: Master Higgins must constantly eat fruit to maintain his stamina while riding skateboards and throwing stone axes to defeat island creatures.

objetivo: Rescue Princess Leilani by surviving various tropical islands.
descripcion_corta: The legendary NES port of "Wonder Boy," featuring Master Higgins.
descripcion_larga: Known for its catchy music and high difficulty, this game became a staple of the NES library, emphasizing momentum and fast-paced platforming.

objetivo: Save Higgins' girlfriend from the evil witch doctor.
descripcion_corta: An improved sequel that introduces dinosaur companions.
descripcion_larga: Players can now ride four different dinosaurs, each with unique abilities (fire, flight, etc.), and store items in an inventory between levels.

objetivo: Rescue Higgins' girlfriend from alien invaders.
descripcion_corta: The most refined entry in the series, featuring expanded dinosaur mechanics.
descripcion_larga: Higgins can now crouch, and the dinosaur roster is expanded. It features a larger world map and a non-linear feel compared to the previous entries.

nombre: Hudson's Adventure Island III (USA) [Hack by Aether Knight v1.0] (~Adventure Island 3 - The Lost Isles)
objetivo: Navigate an entirely new set of islands with increased difficulty.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality level-hack that provides new challenges for AI3 veterans.
descripcion_larga: This version features completely redesigned stages and harder enemy placements, breathing fresh life into the Adventure Island III engine.

objetivo: Save Higgins' girlfriend with the help of your dinosaur friends.
descripcion_corta: The European PAL release of the second Adventure Island adventure.
descripcion_larga: Featuring the same dinosaur-riding mechanics and inventory system, it offers a more balanced and accessible experience than the original title.

objetivo: Pilot a starship to destroy swarms of giant mechanical insects.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed space shooter by Sachen with a bug theme.
descripcion_larga: Players face waves of arthropod-themed enemies and bosses, using a variety of weapon power-ups in a fast-paced arcade-style combat loop.

objetivo: Guide the Red October to the US while avoiding Soviet forces.
descripcion_corta: A tactical submarine game based on the Tom Clancy novel and film.
descripcion_larga: It blends side-scrolling navigation with tactical combat phases, where players must manage sonar, torpedoes, and evasion tactics to survive the journey.

objetivo: Guide the Red October to the US while avoiding Soviet forces.
descripcion_corta: A tactical submarine game based on the Tom Clancy novel and film.
descripcion_larga: It blends side-scrolling navigation with tactical combat phases, where players must manage sonar, torpedoes, and evasion tactics to survive the journey.

nombre: Hunt for Red October, The (USA) (Rev A)
objetivo: Guide the Red October to the US with minor technical fixes.
descripcion_corta: A revised version of the submarine simulation with bug fixes.
descripcion_larga: This revision addresses small glitches in sonar detection and level transitions, ensuring a smoother tactical experience for the player.

objetivo: Lead a parade of spirits through the night to conquer territory.
descripcion_corta: A unique strategy game based on the "Night Parade of One Hundred Demons."
descripcion_larga: Players move Yokai across a map, engaging in tactical battles and random events based on Japanese folklore, all presented with traditional 8-bit art.

nombre: Hyaku no Sekai no Monogatari - The Tales on a Watery Wilderness (Japan)
objetivo: Journey through a fantasy world and reach the goal first.
descripcion_corta: A charming hybrid of a digital board game and a turn-based RPG.
descripcion_larga: Up to four players can compete, moving across tiles that trigger battles, item finds, or story events, creating a "party game" RPG experience.

nombre: Hyaku no Sekai no Monogatari - The Tales on a Watery Wilderness (Japan) [En by AlanMidas v20070425] (~100 World Story, The)
objetivo: Journey through the fantasy world with full English text.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the unique RPG-board game hybrid.
descripcion_larga: This translation is essential for understanding the many random events, item effects, and humorous dialogue that occur as players race across the world map.

objetivo: Find the three jewels and defeat the demon Varalys to save Fairyland.
descripcion_corta: An early and influential (though controversial) action RPG.
descripcion_larga: Known for its "bump" combat system, Hydlide requires players to manage health and level up by attacking enemies. It's a foundational title for the ARPG genre.

objetivo: Stop the darkness from consuming the land in this advanced sequel.
descripcion_corta: A much more complex RPG featuring a weight system and day/night cycles.
descripcion_larga: Hydlide 3 introduced "modern" RPG elements like hunger and a morality system, pushing the Famicom hardware with its deep mechanical systems.

objetivo: Save Fairyland in this enhanced Famicom version of the original game.
descripcion_corta: An updated version of Hydlide featuring improved graphics and sound.
descripcion_larga: This version polishes the original 1984 PC-88 release for the Famicom, offering smoother gameplay and a more vibrant visual palette.

nombre: Hyokkori Hyoutan Jima - Nazo no Kaizokusen (Japan)
objetivo: Solve the mystery of the pirate ship to protect the floating island.
descripcion_corta: An adventure game based on a famous Japanese puppet show.
descripcion_larga: Players explore the island and talk to quirky characters to gather clues and items, solving spatial puzzles to progress the charming narrative.

objetivo: Win gold in various Olympic events in this limited "Prize" edition.
descripcion_corta: A rare promotional version of Hyper Olympic for the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Features the same classic button-mashing gameplay as the original, but holds historical value as a special distribution for Japanese fans.

objetivo: Compete in track and field events to achieve world records.
descripcion_corta: The foundational button-mashing sports game (Track & Field).
descripcion_larga: Players must press buttons rapidly to run and time their presses for jumps and throws. It’s the quintessential 8-bit competitive sports experience.

objetivo: Master new Olympic events like swimming and skeet shooting.
descripcion_corta: The official sequel to Hyper Olympic with more varied events.
descripcion_larga: It expands the roster of sports to include archery, triple jump, and more, requiring different rhythms and timing beyond simple rapid button-mashing.

objetivo: Master new Olympic events with minor bug fixes.
descripcion_corta: A revised release of the Hyper Sports Famicom sequel.
descripcion_larga: This revision ensures better compatibility and fixes minor scoring glitches in certain events like the pole vault or swimming.

objetivo: Lead your female softball team to the national championship.
descripcion_corta: A unique 8-bit sports title focusing on softball instead of baseball.
descripcion_larga: Featuring distinct physics and a female roster, this game offers a fresh take on the ball-and-bat genre with colorful sprites and fast-paced arcade gameplay.

objetivo: Rescue the Smurfs from Gargamel's castle as a brave Smurf.
descripcion_corta: An Italian-language release of "The Smurfs" platformer.
descripcion_larga: Based on the Peyo cartoons, it features impressive 8-bit visuals for a late-release title, challenging players to navigate forests and swamps to reach Gargamel's lair.

objetivo: Scale 32 icy mountains to retrieve stolen vegetables from a giant bird.
descripcion_corta: A foundational Nintendo classic featuring Popo and Nana.
descripcion_larga: Players use hammers to break through layers of ice while avoiding seals and birds. It is famous for its cooperative play and the challenging bonus stage at the peak.

objetivo: Scale 32 icy mountains to retrieve stolen vegetables from a giant bird.
descripcion_corta: A foundational Nintendo classic featuring Popo and Nana.
descripcion_larga: Players use hammers to break through layers of ice while avoiding seals and birds. It is famous for its cooperative play and the challenging bonus stage at the peak.

objetivo: Outscore your opponent in a fast-paced international hockey match.
descripcion_corta: A beloved Nintendo sports title featuring customizable team weights.
descripcion_larga: Players can choose between thin, medium, and fat skaters, each with different speed and power stats, creating a deep layer of strategy for an 8-bit sports game.

objetivo: Outscore your opponent in a fast-paced international hockey match.
descripcion_corta: A beloved Nintendo sports title featuring customizable team weights.
descripcion_larga: Players can choose between thin, medium, and fat skaters, each with different speed and power stats, creating a deep layer of strategy for an 8-bit sports game.

nombre: Ide Yousuke Meijin no Jissen Mahjong (Japan) (Rev A)
objetivo: Defeat Mahjong masters using expert techniques and luck.
descripcion_corta: A professional Mahjong simulation endorsed by expert Yousuke Ide.
descripcion_larga: This version features refined AI and updated logic for more realistic tile-drawing, catering to serious fans of the traditional Japanese four-player game.

nombre: Ide Yousuke Meijin no Jissen Mahjong 2 (Japan)
objetivo: Climb the ranks of the Mahjong world in this expanded sequel.
descripcion_corta: An improved simulation featuring better graphics and a career mode.
descripcion_larga: It includes more detailed tutorials and strategic advice from Ide himself, making it one of the most comprehensive Mahjong titles on the Famicom.

objetivo: Help Erika become a pop star to inherit her grandfather's fortune.
descripcion_corta: An English fan translation of a quirky musical adventure.
descripcion_larga: This translation makes the humorous dialogue and song-based "battles" accessible, allowing Western fans to enjoy this unique idol-themed story.

objetivo: Help Erika become a pop star to inherit her grandfather's fortune.
descripcion_corta: A charming adventure game featuring multiple music-themed endings.
descripcion_larga: As Erika, players travel across Japan to find seven talented companions, blending traditional menu-driven exploration with pop-culture humor and catchy 8-bit tunes.

objetivo: Clear the board by matching pairs of Mahjong tiles.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed "Shisen-sho" style tile-matching puzzle game.
descripcion_larga: Often featuring high-quality idol art as rewards, it challenges the player's pattern recognition skills in a race against the clock.

objetivo: Master the game of Go on a smaller 9x9 grid.
descripcion_corta: A focused version of Go designed for quick play and beginners.
descripcion_larga: By using a smaller board, the game emphasizes the core tactical maneuvers of Go, providing a faster and more intense experience than the full-sized version.

objetivo: Study famous Go matches and solve complex tactical puzzles.
descripcion_corta: A specialized educational title for Go enthusiasts.
descripcion_larga: This game functions as an 8-bit interactive book, allowing players to recreate historical moves and learn from the masters of the game.

objetivo: Improve your Go skills with updated 1991 professional tactics.
descripcion_corta: Part of a long-running series of Go instructional games.
descripcion_larga: It features improved AI and new scenarios based on the professional Go circuit of 1991, offering a serious tool for practice and play.

objetivo: Master the game of Go with refined 1992-era challenges.
descripcion_corta: An updated installment of the popular Go simulation series.
descripcion_larga: Featuring adjusted difficulty levels and more complex endgame scenarios, it continues the series' tradition of high-quality 8-bit board game strategy.

objetivo: Conquer new Go opponents with updated 1993 logic.
descripcion_corta: The third annual update to the Famicom's premier Go series.
descripcion_larga: This version includes a larger library of joseki (standard sequences) and a more aggressive AI, challenging even experienced Go players.

objetivo: Reach the peak of 8-bit Go mastery in this final annual update.
descripcion_corta: The most advanced entry in the Igo Shinan series for Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Representing the technical peak of Go AI on the hardware, it offers the most challenging and complete 8-bit Go experience available.

objetivo: Learn the fundamentals of Go through interactive lessons.
descripcion_corta: The first entry in the long-running Famicom Go instruction series.
descripcion_larga: It established the menu-driven system and AI routines that would make the series a staple for Japanese board game fans on the console.

objetivo: Infiltrate enemy territory as Ralf and Clark to stop a coup.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the legendary SNK arcade port.
descripcion_larga: Known for its intense difficulty and the ability to pilot tanks, it set the standard for military-themed top-down shooters on the Famicom.

objetivo: Battle through mythological realms to defeat the dark gods.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of "Victory Road," the second Ikari game.
descripcion_larga: This sequel moves the series into a sci-fi/fantasy setting, where the heroes fight aliens and monsters using futuristic weapons and mystical swords.

objetivo: Infiltrate the enemy base to rescue the kidnapped president's daughter.

descripcion_corta: A survival-mode hack based on Mega Man 9/10 style.
descripcion_larga: It creates a procedurally generated (randomized) stage where players test their endurance against infinite waves of enemies and hazards.

nombre: Rockman 3 - Dr. Wily no Saigo! (Japan) [Hack by Small Apple v1.0] (~Rockman 3 Alpha)
objetivo: Experience a modified version of the 3rd adventure.

objetivo: Play Rockman 3 with bug fixes and better performance.

objetivo: Fight every boss in the game in a rapid-fire gauntlet.
descripcion_corta: A specialized hack focused entirely on boss fights.
descripcion_larga: Players can jump straight into the action against the Robot Masters and Wily's machines without navigating through the levels.

objetivo: Stop the mysterious Dr. Cossack and his 8 robots.
descripcion_corta: The original Famicom version of Mega Man 4.
descripcion_larga: This entry introduced the "New Mega Buster" (charge shot), adding a new layer of strategy to the core run-and-gun gameplay.

nombre: Rockman 4 - Aratanaru Yabou!! (Japan) [Hack by Rock5easily v20090810] (~Rockman 4 Endless)
objetivo: Test your skills in an infinite looping challenge.
descripcion_corta: A survival-mode hack for the Rockman 4 engine.
descripcion_larga: Much like the 3rd version, it challenges players to see how many "screens" they can clear before losing all their lives.

nombre: Rockman 4 BCAS (Burst Chaser X Air Sliding)
objetivo: Master high-speed movement with air-sliding.
descripcion_corta: A mechanical hack adding "Burst Chaser" abilities.

objetivo: Experience a total conversion with new bosses and art.
descripcion_corta: Widely considered the "king" of Rockman hacks.
descripcion_larga: A masterpiece that changes everything: new weapons, branching paths, custom bosses, and music from other franchises. It's a brand-new game.

objetivo: Defeat the rogue Proto Man and his fake army.
descripcion_corta: The original Famicom version of Mega Man 5.
descripcion_larga: Features some of the best graphics on the system and the debut of "Beat," the bird companion that helps in combat.

nombre: Rockman 5 - Blues no Wana! (Japan) [Hack by Rock5easily v20081215] (~Rockman 5 Endless)
objetivo: Survive the ultimate infinite gauntlet of robots.
descripcion_corta: An endurance hack for the fifth entry.
descripcion_larga: Players must manage their health and weapons carefully to survive through a variety of randomized platforming challenges.

nombre: Rockman 5 - Blues no Wana! (Japan) [Hack by Rock5easily v20081215] (~Rockman 5 Endless) (No Laser Areas)
objetivo: Survive the endless mode without lethal laser traps.
descripcion_corta: A modified version of the Endless hack.
descripcion_larga: Removes the controversial "instant-death" laser sections from the random generation, focusing on pure combat and platforming.

nombre: Rockman 5 - Blues no Wana! (Japan) [Hack by Tar v1.0] (~Rockman 5 - Wily's Dream Space)

objetivo: Traverse levels with a new double-jump ability.

nombre: Romancia (Japan) [En by DvD Rev A] (~Dragon Slayer Jr. - Romancia)
